chat.welcomeMessage:
Nnọọ! 👋 M bụ onye enyemaka gị n'ọrụ ugbo.

M nwere ike inyere gị aka na:
• Ihe ọkụkụ, akwụkwọ nri, mkpụrụ osisi, na okooko osisi
• Anụ ụlọ, ọkụkọ, na ịzụ azụ
• Nchịkwa ahụhụ na ọrịa
• Amụma ihu igwe na ndụmọdụ ahịa

Kedu ka m ga-esi nyere gị aka taa?
